title: HEXBEAT SETTINGS
description: Human-editable settings metadata. The Settings panel reads this file; it contains no executable code.

settings.label: Framerate cap
settings.description: Limits HEXBEAT drawing frequency. The browser and display refresh rate remain the upper bound.

settings.label: V-Sync
settings.description: Canvas presentation is synchronized by the browser compositor. A web page cannot reliably switch hardware V-Sync on or off.

settings.label: MOD MENU
settings.description: Shows or hides the map-speed and player-speed difficulty controls.

settings.label: Map Speed
settings.description: Changes how quickly incoming walls travel.

settings.label: Player Speed
settings.description: Changes the player's maximum turning speed.

settings.label: Music Volume
settings.description: Controls level music and menu previews.

settings.label: Sound Volume
settings.description: Sound effects are not implemented yet; only music is currently available.
